results.title: Langflow code injection advisory (GHSA-rvqx-wpfh-mfx7)
results.content: Langflow versions before 1.3.0 let an unauthenticated attacker run code through the /api/v1/validate/code endpoint. Upgrade to 1.3.0.

results.title: CISA adds Langflow flaw to KEV as attacks begin
results.content: CISA added CVE-2025-3248 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue after reports of attacks on exposed Langflow servers.
